entities.summary: Jay Boogie is a Nigerian transgender fashion enthusiast, brand influencer and social media personality who founded JaySecrets. She became famous on Instagram in her early twenties, with her gender transition gaining attention from Nigerians on social media platforms. Boogie has been listed among the top five crossdressers in Nigeria alongside Bobrisky and James Brown.
